A clue will enable the quest icon and the quest will depend on the rank of the clue. You can click it and check what the quest is about.

The quest itself will have some title regarding the treasure hunt from there you will know thats the right quest. If the quest is normal one (can be obtained in adv mediator) do not accept it and the clue will not be lost.

You can also discard your current theme and pick a new one and the clues you already gathered will still be there.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Part of the Truth of the Rumours (No.1) Memorial Album. See details on its page. Stats (since they're buried in the old comments):

+2 Theology
+1 Sundries trading
No effect (loses dura at sea if not kept in bank/quarters vault)

Note: you can farm as many Ancient Glass Fragments as you want; you just have to repeat the clue synthesis until you have a relic quest and then take it again (limit one Relic Quest per day).

This item can also be sacrificed in order to access the Avalon Treasure Hunt theme. As I stated once before, the game doesn't care if you discover it via quest, buy it from a shop or fish it out of the sea with Flotsam Search ship skill -- just have it in your possession and Avalon TH will appear at any barkeep in the world.

Caution: once you sacrifice the Ancient Glass Fragment to take the Avalon TH, it will be removed from your inventory. If you discard the Avalon theme, it cannot be re-accepted until you have a new AGF key item in your possession.

That's it. Cheers.
